demos.label: 1. CoAssist Copay
demos.description: CoAssist Copay Program variation, currently a direct copy of CoAssist DTP (WF3), pending its own divergent behavior

demos.label: 2. PAP, Web enrollment
demos.description: The patient enrolls on Sanofi Patient Connection. Benefits verification finds no coverage, so the case moves to the patient assistance program. The patient confirms by text, completes the income form, and schedules a shipment. ARx Patient Solutions Pharmacy dispenses.

program.name: Patient Assistance Connection
paQuestions: Does the patient have a confirmed diagnosis of type 1 or type 2 diabetes mellitus?
Does the patient require a long-acting (basal) insulin to control blood glucose?
Has the patient tried and failed, or had an adverse reaction to, a plan-preferred basal insulin?
Is the requested dose within the FDA-labeled range, with no other basal insulin prescribed at the same time?

indication.name: A long-acting man-made-insulin used to control high blood sugar in adults and children with diabetes mellitus.
